dedupe_keys.name: dados do historico de despacho de energia de janeiro 2021 a setembro 2024

description: ONS publishes historical half-hourly generation values used when closing the daily operation programme from January 2021 to September 2024. The dictionary identifies programme date, submarket, plant type, plant code and name, dispatch interval and generation value. These scheduled quantities support retrospective dispatch studies. The archive is no longer updated. ONS warns that January to September 2024 can contain inconsistencies caused by changes to the participating-plant register. Coverage is generating plants and electricity submarkets in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
